title: Reunion of Old Companions
next_chapter_hook: Just as the two were about to leave the ruined temple, the black paper crane left by Ye Qing suddenly ignited on its own, transforming into a demonic pattern projected in the air— that was the highest-level distress signal of the Holy Sect (Demonic Path).

text.content: The sigh deep within the Tianji Sword seemed to traverse countless ages, carrying the same desolate melancholy as Chen Tianming. Chen Ji's fingers gripping the sword hilt suddenly tightened, his knuckles turning white. He could feel the grief contained within that wisp of remnant soul— was it a father's accusation against the unfairness of fate, or worry for his son's future? The Tianji Record Fragment at his chest grew faintly warm, as if responding to some kind of summoning. Chen Ji closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and suppressed the chaotic thoughts. "Father... is there anything else you wish to tell me?" However, what answered him was only prolonged silence, along with that faint, barely perceptible warmth from the depths of the Tianji Sword's spirit.

The night wind was like a blade, pouring through the broken window lattices of the ruined temple, stirring up scattered dead leaves across the ground. Chen Ji leaned against the wall, draped in a patched old robe, looking nothing like that spirited Tianqing Sect disciple from three days prior. His features had been simply disguised, the sharpness in his brows and eyes deliberately concealed, making him appear like a down-and-out wandering cultivator. Only in the depths of those eyes still burned the flame of unwillingness to be ordinary. "Ling Yuan..." Chen Ji murmured this name softly, a cold smile curving his lips, "Did you think faking your death could deceive everyone? Unfortunately, you miscalculated one person."

Suddenly, Chen Ji's pupils contracted. A strange tremor emanated from his chest— it was the Tianji Record Fragment sending a warning. Unlike any previous danger, this tremor carried an eerie sense of familiarity, as if someone far away was following certain clues to find him. "Impossible..." Chen Ji rose abruptly, the flying dagger already in his palm. Just then, light footsteps sounded outside the ruined temple, steady and rhythmic, each step striking Chen Ji's heartstrings. The newcomer's lightness skill was extraordinary, yet they deliberately made their presence known— this was a silent declaration: "I know you're in there."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I know you're in there." The cold female voice pierced through the night wind, carrying a barely perceptible tremor, "Did you think hiding in this ruined temple could deceive me? Did you think you were the only one who could use the resonance between Tianji Record Fragments?" As the voice fell, a figure appeared at the temple entrance. Moonlight poured down, illuminating that icy-cold, exceptionally beautiful face— it was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect. Clad in a plain white long robe with her hair simply coiled up, weariness from days of rushing showed between her brows, but those eyes remained sharp as swords, fixed directly on the darkness within the temple.

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely watching the figure at the entrance. Moonlight stretched Su Qingyao's shadow long, extending all the way to Chen Ji's feet. The two faced each other across the dim temple hall, the air seeming to solidify. Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, from his crude disguise to his deliberately suppressed cultivation aura, finally settling on the short sword hidden in his sleeve. "This attire..." she snorted coldly, "Anyone else might truly have been fooled. Unfortunately, you forgot one thing." She raised her hand, and a jade slip glowing with faint light materialized in her palm— that was another fragment of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Three days ago, Tianqing Sect announced your death during the Ancient Forbidden Land trial." Su Qingyao spoke word by word, her voice suppressing anger, "Ling Yuan personally delivered the eulogy, and the entire sect mourned for three days. I didn't believe it." She stepped forward, moonlight forming a halo behind her,衬得她如同九天玄女下凡, "A Tianji Record Fragment would never recognize a dead person as its master. From the moment you faked your death, I knew you were laying a scheme." Her gaze suddenly turned sharp, "Chen Ji, what exactly are you scheming? Why didn't you tell me?"

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed. That smile carried a hint of bitterness, a trace of self-mockery, and an imperceptible relief he hadn't even noticed himself. "Senior Sister Su, you shouldn't have come." He slowly stepped out from the shadows, moonlight illuminating his disguised face, "Ling Yuan has already suspected you. You appearing by my side at this time will only redirect his attention from me, this discarded pawn, to you." His voice was soft, yet every word was clear, "My fake death was to draw away his attention. Your coming to find me plays right into his trap."

text.content: Su Qingyao did not retreat; instead, she took another step forward. The distance between her and Chen Ji was now less than three feet, close enough to see the bloodshot threads in each other's eyes. "Chen Ji, listen carefully." Her voice suddenly softened, yet carried undeniable resolve, "I never cared what Ling Yuan thought. Three years ago at the Outer Court Tournament, when you were framed and nearly killed on the Arena Platform, who was the one who took that sword for you? It was me." She stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, "Did you think I didn't know you were deliberately pretending to be atrash? Did you think I didn't notice the calculations in your eyes every time you looked at me? But so what?"

dialogue.content: "For these three years, I've investigated everything about you." Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly, but she continued to stare at him, "The clan extermination case before you entered the sect, your father Chen Xuan's disappearance, all the hardships you suffered in the Outer Court... I've investigated it all." She took a deep breath, a gleam of moisture flashing in her eyes, "Did you think you walked this path alone? You're wrong. From the very beginning, there was someone watching over you." She paused, her voice dropping, "That person, is me."

text.content: Silence fell upon the ruined temple, terrifyingly complete. Only the night wind mourned as it passed through the window lattices, carrying with it a rustling sound. The hand Chen Ji held the flying dagger with stiffened slightly, his knuckles turning white. He looked at this woman before him— for three years, he thought he had hidden well, thought everyone had been fooled by his act of playing the pig to eat the tiger. Yet it turned out... from the very beginning to the end, there had been a pair of eyes silently watching him. "You..." His voice was hoarse, his Adam's apple bobbing slightly, "Why would you do this?"

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's questioning and confession, Chen Ji must make a choice— continue pushing her away, or discard his disguise and face this emotion directly?

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao the cruel truth: anyone who stays by Chen Ji's side will become a target, including her family and the entire Tianqing Sect.
choices.visible_reward: Obtained crucial intelligence: Su Qingyao brought a message from Ye Qing

dialogue.content: "You should know what kind of person I am." Chen Ji's voice cooled, "From the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, fate has already nailed me to the roasting spit. Ling Yuan wants to kill me, the Eye of Heavenly Dao watches in the shadows, and even the Holy Sect (Demonic Path) views me as a chess piece." He turned around, his back to Su Qingyao, "The sword you took for me three years ago, I remember it. But precisely because I remember, I cannot let you continue staying by my side."

choices.description: Admit that he has been pretending all along, tell her the true thoughts of these three years, and rarely reveal a vulnerable side.
choices.visible_cost: Partial information about the fake death scheme leaked
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's Affection greatly increased, unlocked "Side by Side" status

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a long while, his shoulders trembling slightly. When he spoke again, his voice carried an exhaustion and vulnerability never seen before. "Do you know how I've gotten through these three years?" He turned around, his eyes slightly reddened, "Every day I wake up, the first thing I do is calculate today's mortality rate. Every time I use the Tianji Record, I have to weigh how much Heavenly Fate I have left." He looked at Su Qingyao, a bitter smile tugging at his lips, "I thought as long as I pushed everyone away, I wouldn't have any weaknesses. But..."

text.content: Su Qingyao did not speak, only watching him silently. Moonlight filtered through the broken roof, casting mottled shadows across her face. She could see the deep exhaustion hidden in Chen Ji's eyes, could feel the suppressed trembling in his voice. This man... when did he start pushing himself so hard? She stepped forward, closing the distance between them once more. "Chen Ji," her voice was soft, yet exceptionally firm, "I did not come to beg for your acceptance. I came to tell you something."

dialogue.content: "A month ago, Ye Qing, the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, sent a secret letter." Su Qingyao took out a small black paper crane from her bosom, "The letter said she has a way to suppress the aura of the Tianji Record, so that neither Ling Yuan nor the Eye of Heavenly Dao could track you. But she has one condition—" She paused, her gaze fixed directly on Chen Ji's eyes, "She said the 'Twin Fated Ones' have already appeared. They wish to meet you of their own accord." She handed the paper crane to Chen Ji, "This is Ye Qing's message. She said if you want to know Chen Nian's whereabouts, you must meet these two people."

text.content: Chen Nian. Chen Ji's hand froze mid-motion. That name was like a sharp blade, cruelly piercing the softest part of his heart. His younger sister, the girl taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' his closest kin he had searched for years yet never found any trace of. "Twin Fated Ones..." Chen Ji murmured, his brow furrowed tightly. The Tianji Record had never contained this information—what did it mean? A new variable, or a greater trap? His fingers unconsciously rubbed against the paper crane's wings as various possibilities raced through his mind.

choice.prompt: Facing this major clue about his sister, Chen Ji must decide his next move.

choices.text: Meet the Twin Fated Ones Immediately
choices.description: Risk meeting the mysterious Twin Fated Ones for Chen Nian's whereabouts, even if it might be a trap.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Key Clue About Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Opposing Side's Intentions Unknown, Possible Ambush

text.content: "I want to see her." Chen Ji hardly hesitated, his voice carrying a long-suppressed urgency. His hands trembled slightly—it was the first time in three years he had lost control due to emotional fluctuation. Su Qingyao watched his state, a flash of heartache flickering in her eyes. She had never seen Chen Ji so discomposed—that man who calculated everything, when it came to his sister, ultimately revealed his most genuine emotions.

choices.description: Consolidate intelligence from both sides, devise a foolproof strategy before acting, while strengthening the alliance with Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's Full Support, Unlock 'Shared Destiny' Prerequisite
choices.risk_hint: Twin Fated Ones May Change Their Minds

dialogue.content: "Wait." Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He looked at Su Qingyao, his gaze gradually regaining its usual sharpness, "Why is Ye Qing willing to help me? What does she want? What is the background of the Twin Fated Ones?" He took the paper crane, examining it carefully, "Is there any other content in this letter?" Su Qingyao nodded, taking another thin silk from her sleeve, covered densely in tiny characters. "This is intelligence I risked exposure to intercept from the Holy Sect's insider."

text.content: The information on the thin silk made Chen Ji's brow furrow even tighter. The Twin Fated Ones—according to rumors, they were a brother and sister from ancient times erased by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, wandering the world as remnant souls until recently reforming their physical bodies. More eerily, the intelligence mentioned: "The keyhole of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key lies within the Eyes of the Twins." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. What did this mean? Was there some inevitable connection between Chen Nian as the Heavenly Fate Lock Key and this pair of twins?

dialogue.content: "There's one more thing." Su Qingyao's voice suddenly dropped, carrying a hint of imperceptible worry, "Ling Yuan has been frequently contacting people from the Xuanwu Sect recently. I suspect he's planning some big move." She looked at Chen Ji, her eyes full of concern, "Your feigned death can be hidden for at most half a month. After half a month, whether you're willing or not, you'll be drawn into the center of that storm." She paused, "So, we have no time to waste."

choice.prompt: Facing the urgent situation and multiple threats, Chen Ji needs to decide how to respond to the collusion between Ling Yuan and the Xuanwu Sect.

choices.description: Utilize the Tianji Record's foresight ability to strike first and expose Ling Yuan's conspiracy, disrupting enemy arrangements.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Key Evidence of Ling Yuan's Conspiracy
choices.risk_hint: Overusing the Tianji Record Will Accelerate Heavenly Fate Point Consumption

dialogue.content: "Since it's come to this, let Ling Yuan see what it means to have calculations that miss nothing." A fierce light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment on his chest suddenly grew scorching hot. He was preparing to use that ability to foresee the future—even if it would consume his precious Heavenly Fate Points. Su Qingyao watched his movements and suddenly reached out to press his wrist. "Wait!" Her voice carried urgency, "Every time you use the Tianji Record, you consume Heavenly Fate Points. How many Heavenly Fate Points do you have left?"

choices.description: Uniting the power of Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, weaving a web of intelligence against Ling Yuan in the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to strike with lethal force.
choices.visible_reward: Acquire Detailed Intelligence Network Within the Three Sects
choices.risk_hint: May Face a Passive Situation of Being Struck First

dialogue.content: "No need." Chen Ji shook his head, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. "Ling Yuan thinks I'm dead, thinks I'm just a lucky wretch who stumbled upon the Tianji Record. The more he underestimates me, the easier it'll be for him to reveal his weaknesses." He took out the jade token that had always been hidden close to his body from his embrace—the token that served as the inherited object of successive Tianqing Sect Masters. "This is enough to make Ling Yuan restless." Su Qingyao glanced at the jade token, a flash of surprise crossing her eyes. "Where did you get this?"

text.content: "This is Father's legacy." Chen Ji's voice was low, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. "He brought it out when he escaped from Ling Yuan's hands. It records the secrets of succession by successive Masters, including... how Ling Yuan murdered the previous Master to seize power." Su Qingyao drew a sharp breath. She knew Chen Ji's father Chen Xuan had been a candidate for the previous generation's Tianji Record inheritance, but she never knew he had left such a trump card. "Chen Ji..." She looked at the man before her, an indescribable emotion surging in her heart. How many more secrets was this man hiding?

A soft sound suddenly came from outside the ruined temple. Su Qingyao and Chen Ji both tensed, each taking a step back, spiritual energy condensing at their fingertips. However, the next moment, a black paper crane flew in through the window lattice and ignited before them. The flame presented a bizarre ink-green color, sketching a line of text in mid-air: "Leave immediately. Tianqing Sect pursuers have arrived. — Ye Qing" The characters had barely formed before turning to ash and dispersing. Su Qingyao's expression shifted slightly. She looked at Chen Ji. "It seems our conversation needs to move to another location."

dialogue.content: "Follow me." Chen Ji didn't hesitate for a moment, grabbing Su Qingyao's wrist and darting toward the back window. His movements were crisp and decisive, with no hesitation whatsoever. Su Qingyao was pulled by him through the broken window lattice, landing on the path of the Rear Mountain. The night wind tousled her hair, yet it couldn't dispel the faint smile at the corner of her lips. For three years, she had finally been able to stand by this person's side, fighting shoulder to shoulder with him. "Chen Ji," she softly called out, her voice carrying a tenderness she had never shown before, "whatever lies ahead, I will be with you."

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly. He didn't look back, yet he could feel the fervor of that gaze behind him. For three years, he had been walking this road bristling with thorns alone. He thought this path was destined to be walked by him alone, never expecting that someone would be willing to walk alongside him. "Su Qingyao," his voice was very soft, yet carried an unprecedented seriousness, "thank you for coming to find me." Simple five words, yet they seemed to have exhausted all his courage. Su Qingyao's eyes reddened slightly, but she didn't let the tears fall.

Moonlight was like water, sprinkling over the two figures running side by side. In the distant direction of the Tianqing Sect, sword lights flickered faintly—the signal that the pursuers had mobilized. But Chen Ji wasn't flustered. He had already laid seventeen hidden stakes in these mountains and forests, thirty-six types of escape methods. As long as Su Qingyao was by his side, he had confidence to lead her to safety. However, what he didn't notice was that just when he spoke those words of "thank you," the remnant soul deep within the Tianji Record trembled slightly, as if responding to something. And the riddle about the "Twin Destinies of Fate" was also quietly unveiling its mysterious veil in the shadows...
